question: A mother's age is double her son's age at present. If the difference of their ages after 24 years from now is 20, then find their ages at present (in years), respectively.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age difference remains constant always

After 24 years difference = 20 ⇒ present difference also = 20

Mother = 2 × Son ⇒ difference = Son

So Son = 20 and Mother = 40

**∴ Answer = 40 years and 20 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mother's age = 2 × Son's age and difference after 24 years = 20

**Formula used:**

Age difference remains constant and linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let son's present age = x

⇒ Mother's present age = 2x

⇒ After 24 years: Son = x + 24, Mother = 2x + 24

⇒ Difference = (2x + 24) − (x + 24)

⇒ = x

⇒ Given difference = 20 ⇒ x = 20

⇒ Mother's age = 2x = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40 years and 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Difference Rule

The difference between ages of two people remains constant over time.

Linear Equations

Age problems can be solved using simple algebraic expressions.

Future Age Concept

After n years, add n to present ages.

Ratio Insight

If one age is double, difference equals the smaller age.
